blocks.content: Now we'll use if and else the way our quiz game needs them: to decide whether the player passed or failed.
Here, percentage >= passMark is the condition.

items: If it's true, we print the pass message.
If it's false, we print the fail message.

blocks.content: This is one of the main decisions in our game. Later, we'll calculate score and percentage from real answers — but the decision logic stays the same.
